text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Aston Machan declares to 
the press that her next goal is the 
Fantasy Stakes. Her Trainer, having heard 
nothing of this plan, is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling it was because she wasn't 
dependable enough, she threw herself into 
PR activities—making Chan-m~ dolls and 
even putting on a mascot suit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan was full of praise for that 
momentum! She then asked you to come with 
her to the URA Planning & Production 
Department—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A direct appeal to become the official 
mascot! The answer was... "It's tough 
without notable achievements." And so, the 
two had to go back to the drawing board.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To get made into a mascot plushie, I need 
to build up my race record. First up: a 
standout performance at the Fantasy 
Stakes!
